stories.title: Missing 74-year-old woman found dead in Oceana County woods
stories.summary: After a 74-year-old Shelby woman went unheard from since Friday, a search involving dozens of responders located her Wednesday.

stories.title: Search crews find missing 83-year-old hunter in Alpena Township
stories.summary: An 83-year-old man who went missing in Alpena Township was found alive Wednesday after a search involving multiple agencies.

stories.title: Man accused of planning to kill family and launch mass shooting arraigned in Muskegon County after initial round of charges
stories.summary: Stewart Lee Simon was arraigned in Muskegon County on terrorism and explosives charges. He already faces four charges in Oceana County.

stories.title: Bank robbery reported in Kalamazoo, PNC offering $5,000 reward for information
stories.summary: A bank in the 1700 block of South Westnedge Avenue was robbed Wednesday. No injuries have been reported.

stories.title: Muskegon Heights vet awaits property tax refund amid mayor signature delay
stories.summary: Marine Corps Veteran John Horan says his back taxes owed by the city aren't being paid out to him because the mayor hasn't been able to sign and approve his check.

stories.title: 2 hurt after accidental shooting in Mecosta County
stories.summary: Two people were seriously injured in what deputies described as an accidental shooting in Chippewa Township on Wednesday.

stories.title: Governor Gretchen Whitmer honors 'the best university in the world' during final turkey pardon
stories.summary: Gretchen Whitmer honors her alma mater, Michigan State University, during her final Thanksgiving turkey pardon.

stories.title: Muskegon man agrees to plead guilty in federal drug conspiracy case linked to city hall raid
stories.summary: Lakento Smith admitted to a drug trafficking conspiracy in Muskegon County and faces a minimum of 15 years after agreeing to plead guilty to federal charges.

stories.title: Driver accused of using 'whip-its,' going 90 mph before deadly crash on I-196
stories.summary: A man is charged in a fatal I-196 crash after a witness told investigators he was using nitrous oxide "whip-its" and driving 90 mph.

stories.title: Ravenna football captain with 3.8 GPA leads team during history-making season
stories.summary: Ravenna won its first regional championship since 2010 on Saturday, and at the center of it all was our latest Robinson Dental Scholar Athlete, Jaxson Wilburn.

stories.title: OPENING DAY | coucou bakehouse is officially open in Grand Rapids
stories.summary: The bakery offers a wide variety of rotating menu items, including cheesecakes, cookies, donuts, pudding, tiramisu, focaccia, sandwiches, matcha and more.

stories.title: Cedar Trails Elementary students creating their own Thanksgiving parade balloons
stories.summary: The students will hold a parade next week to share their designs. School staff are hoping the event becomes an annual Thanksgiving tradition.
